_comentario: INVENTARIO DE LABVIEW (design/05-decisions.md, DT-035). Lo que muestra la
interfaz de la referencia y la situación de Solder respecto a cada cosa.
El editor toma de aquí el veredicto de cada elemento (spec/05-editor.md,
regla 55), y la página docs/inventario-labview.md se generará a partir de
este fichero. Formato: inventario-labview.schema.json.
Un área se desglosa al empezar a trabajar en ella, con las capturas de la
referencia delante (DT-035 §5 y §8). No se escribe nada de memoria.
DESGLOSADO: el Front Panel y el Block Diagram de un VI nuevo (capturas
front-panel/vi-nuevo.png y block-diagram/vi-nuevo.png; nombres de la barra
según la página «VI Toolbar Buttons» de la ayuda de NI) y el Project Explorer
de un proyecto nuevo, contra la captura
project-explorer/proyecto-nuevo.png (2026-09-29). Lo que la captura muestra
—ventana, menús, barras, páginas y árbol— está verificado. Los nombres de los
botones no aparecen en la captura (son tooltips): salen de la ayuda de NI,
páginas «Standard/Project/Build/Source Control Toolbar Buttons», consultadas
el mismo día. El contenido de los menús no se ha capturado todavía.
CONTROLS ▸ MODERN ▸ BOOLEAN (2026-10-01): capturas paletas/controls-boolean.png (13
elementos en 3 columnas, con sus nombres de pasar el ratón), los controles puestos en
el panel, apagados y tras un clic (front-panel/boolean-todos-apagados.png y
boolean-todos-tras-clic.png), sus terminales (block-diagram/boolean-terminales-icono.png,
boolean-terminal-compacto.png, boolean-ayuda-contextual.png) y los menús de clic derecho:
front-panel/boolean-menu-control.png, boolean-menu-indicator.png, boolean-menu-stop-button.png
(con Release Text, sin declarar) y boolean-menu-mechanical-action.png, con las seis acciones.
PALETA DE FUNCIONES: capturas paletas/functions-programming.png (normal) y
paletas/functions-programming-desplegada.png (con las categorías ocultas a
la vista); nombres según la ayuda de NI («Programming», «Using the Controls
and Functions Palettes», «Showing and Hiding Palette Categories»).
FUERA de la paleta, por ser módulos, drivers o toolkits: las categorías Vision
and Motion, Control & Simulation, FPGA Interface y TestStand, y tres iconos de
Programming que no son de LabVIEW (uno, el del Unit Test Framework).
FUNCTIONS ▸ PROGRAMMING ▸ STRING y CONTROLS ▸ MODERN ▸ STRING & PATH (2026-10-01): capturas
string/string-subpaleta.png (28 elementos en 5 columnas), string-numstr-abierta.png (12 en 7),
string-additional-abierta.png (13 en 4), string-path-array-string-abierta.png (6 en 4),
string-flatten-abierta.png (9 en 2) y controls-string-path.png (5 en 3), con los nombres de la
ayuda contextual de cada función (ayuda-*.png) y las pruebas que dan los resultados medidos
(prueba-*.png). 27 funciones y constantes hechas, y String Control y String Indicator; el
resto, en gris con su motivo (expresiones regulares, el diálogo de formato, arrays, rutas…).
SUBPALETA NUMERIC: captura paletas/functions-numeric.png (abierta desde la
paleta); nombres según la página «Numeric» de la ayuda de NI, sin el sufijo
Function o VI que lleva allí el título de cada tema. Sus 32 funciones están
hechas (DT-038 b): se ponen en el diagrama con los terminales del catálogo y
se cablean. Compilarlas es de ejecutar-vi.
DIAGRAMA CON NUMERIC: vídeo block-diagram/numeric-cablear.mp4 y sus fotogramas
block-diagram/numeric-*.png (2026-09-30): el botón Enter Text de la barra y los
menús de clic derecho de una función (sobre Add) y de una constante numérica.
El de la constante sale cortado tras Replace: lo que sigue no está declarado.
El menú Edit sigue sin capturar, aunque Ctrl+Z ya deshace en el diagrama.
PALETA DE CONTROLES Y PANEL: capturas paletas/controls.png (normal),
paletas/controls-desplegada.png (con las categorías ocultas) y
paletas/controls-numeric.png, y el vídeo front-panel/numeric-colocar-etiquetas.mp4
con sus fotogramas: front-panel/numeric-*.png, block-diagram/numeric-terminales*.png
y los menús de clic derecho de los terminales, block-diagram/numeric-menu-control.png
y numeric-menu-indicador.png (2026-09-30). Nombres de las carpetas de Modern y
de los controles de Numeric según la ayuda de NI («Modern Palette», «Numeric
Controls»). FUERA, por ser módulos o toolkits: las categorías Control &
Simulation y TestStand. Hechos el control y el indicador numéricos: se ponen
en el panel con su terminal en el diagrama, y su etiqueta se escribe y se
mueve en cada lienzo. El menú de clic derecho de un control en el panel no
está capturado.
SUBPALETA BOOLEAN: capturada por Solder en LabVIEW 2026 Q3 Community,
instalado en la máquina virtual de Windows, a escala 1:1 (2026-09-30):
paletas/functions-boolean.png, con la paleta en vista Category (Standard), y
block-diagram/boolean-funciones.png, con las funciones puestas en el diagrama.
Los nombres, los que enseña la subpaleta al pasar el ratón; los terminales, los
de la ventana de ayuda contextual. En la paleta Boolean, Compound Arithmetic
sale en modo AND (lo dice su ayuda).
MENÚ FILE: capturado en LabVIEW 2026 Q3 Community, en la VM, en las dos ventanas
del VI (front-panel/menu-file.png y block-diagram/menu-file.png): es el mismo.
Hechos Open, Save, Save As y Exit.
COMPOUND ARITHMETIC: vídeo block-diagram/compound-arithmetic.mp4, sus fotogramas
block-diagram/compound-*.png y la captura compound-menu.png (2026-09-30): el
menú del nodo y el de una entrada. Los submenús salen cortados por la ventana:
de Change Mode se ven Add y Multiply; AND, OR y XOR son los modos que da la
ayuda de NI («Compound Arithmetic»), y AND se ve en el vídeo por su efecto.
FUERA, según DT-035 §3: la barra del toolkit Unit Test Framework (entre
Project y Build en la captura del Project Explorer). SIN DECLARAR hasta
confirmarlos: el cuadrado verde tras Build en el Project Explorer (¿Package
Dependencies?), su rombo verde (¿Nigel?) y el «26.0» de la barra del VI.
SUBPALETA STRUCTURES (2026-10-01): capturada en LabVIEW 2026 Q3 Community, en la VM, a
escala 1:1, en labview-captures/structures/: la subpaleta (paleta.png: 4 columnas, 16
elementos; nombres.png, de pasar el ratón por cada uno), el While Loop y el For Loop
soltados con un rectángulo (while-loop.png, for-loop.png) y con un clic (minimo-*.png), el
shift register (shift-register.png), los túneles (tunel-entrada.png, tunel-salida.png), la
selección con sus ocho asas (seleccion.png) y los menús de clic derecho del borde de cada
bucle y de cada nodo de su borde (menu-*.png). Hechos el While Loop y el For Loop, con
sus terminales de iteración, condición y cuenta, los túneles de entrada y de salida (Last
Value) y los shift registers; el resto de la subpaleta, en gris.
FLAT Y STACKED SEQUENCE (2026-10-01): capturadas en la misma VM, en labview-captures/structures/:
secuencia-2.png (Flat de 250 × 200 con un marco), secuencia-3.png y -4.png (con un marco más y
estirada), secuencia-8.png (Stacked, con su selector), secuencia-9.png a -14.png (variable
local de secuencia: sin cablear, escribiendo, leyendo y en un marco anterior), secuencia-15.png
(el cable entre marcos de una Flat), secuencia-16.png (mínimo), secuencia-seleccion.png y
los menús del borde: secuencia-menu-borde.png (Flat), secuencia-menu-stacked.png y
secuencia-menu-stacked-replace.png; secuencia-run*.png, la ejecución cronometrada. Hechos
Flat Sequence Structure (en la paleta), Add Frame After/Before, Delete This Frame y
Replace con la otra secuencia; la Stacked sólo sale de Replace (no está en la paleta).
FUNCTIONS ▸ PROGRAMMING ▸ CLUSTER, CLASS, & VARIANT (2026-10-15): captured in LabVIEW 2026 Q3
Community, in the VM, at 1:1, in labview-captures/cluster/ (report
labview-captures/reports/2026-10-15-cluster-palette.md): the subpalette (s4.png, pal_s.png: 5
columns, 19 elements and the thumbtack; names.png, the names shown on hover), the Variant folder opened (v1.png),
the four bundle and unbundle nodes dropped (d1.png) and their context help (ch1–ch4). Only the
cluster side is planned; classes and variants are declared and wait for their own pieces.

leer-escribir-qvi.desc: reading and writing a .qvi according to its schema (the tk-format crate)

formato-sdproj.desc: The format of the project file, .sdproj (.qproj before DT-051): its schema, reading and writing. Without it there is no project to show

modelo-de-dependencias.desc: a dependency model between VIs, libraries and projects
modelo-de-dependencias.ref: spec/02-syntax.md §8: set by spec/03, not yet written

construir-distribuible.desc: building a distributable from a VI or a project (solder build)

panel-frontal.desc: drawing and editing a VI's panel: its controls and indicators

diagrama.desc: drawing and editing a VI's diagram: nodes, wires and structures

ejecutar-vi.desc: compiling a VI to WebAssembly and running it from the editor

puntos-de-parada-en-estructuras.desc: putting a breakpoint on a structure (While, For, Case, sequences): the compiler only tells the debugger about nodes, not about their borders

sondas-a-medida.desc: the probes other than the generic one: the one that toggles highlighting, the conditional one, the history one, the one made with a control and custom ones

advertencias.desc: computing a VI's warnings (unused or hidden objects, unwired panel terminals) for the error list

sondas.desc: saving and reading the last value that passed through each wire

formato-de-texto.desc: font, size and style of text, saved in the .qvi's presentation layer

busqueda-en-paletas.desc: searching for functions, controls and examples by name or by what they do

ayuda-contextual.desc: describing what is under the mouse, from the desc field of the block catalogue

icono-del-vi.desc: The VI's own icon: how it is stored in the .qvi and the icon editor that draws it. Postponed on 2026-10-08 by the developer: the icon editor is almost an application of its own, and until then every VI uses Solder's standard subVI icon

bloques.desc: declaring the category's blocks in the catalogue, with their terminals and icon, so they can be placed in the diagram. Compiling them is a separate piece: ejecutar-vi
bloques.ref: schema/blocks.json; reference/history/00-provisional-plan.md §7, phases R2 to R5

expresiones-regulares.desc: LabVIEW's regular expressions: Match Pattern, Match Regular Expression and the Regular Expression mode of Search and Replace String

formato-con-dialogo.desc: the Edit Format String dialog and the functions that give or read text according to a format string, with inputs that grow and of different types (Format Into String, Scan From String, Format Value, Scan Value)

clase-de-caracteres.desc: which bytes count as printable and how LabVIEW numbers the lexical classes: Printable? and Lexical Class, not yet measured in LabVIEW

aplanar-datos.desc: flattening data to binary, XML or JSON strings and rebuilding it, with variants

tipos-numericos.desc: adding the types Solder does not have yet: 80-bit extended precision (EXT), complex numbers (CSG, CDB, CXT) and fixed point (FXP), with their conversion
tipos-numericos.ref: design/05-decisions.md, DT-038 §5: left them out; reopened on 2026-10-01 as pending, with no decision on how

menus-contextuales.desc: the commands and submenus of the diagram's right-click menus

etiquetas.desc: the labels of the diagram's nodes: showing, hiding and editing them (DT-022)

ejemplos.desc: looking for examples that use a function

descripciones.desc: each object's own description and tip strip, saved in the .qvi

propiedades.desc: the properties dialog of a diagram node

definiciones-de-tipo.desc: type definitions saved in their own file and linked from the VIs

drivers-de-adquisicion.desc: instrument I/O and acquisition blocks (VISA, serial, DAQ), each with its own gate

librerias.desc: Libraries, .sdlib (.qlib before DT-051): their format, where they are installed and how they appear in the palettes

personalizar-paletas.desc: customising the palettes: favourites and visible categories

paletas-fijas.desc: pinning a palette as a window of its own, which remembers its position and size

asistente-externo.desc: launching from the editor an external AI assistant that works on the .qvi

estilos-de-controles.desc: LabVIEW's other control styles (Fuse, Silver, System, Classic): the same control with another look

controles-de-plataforma.desc: controls that embed platform components, such as .NET and ActiveX on Windows. Undecided whether Solder will have an equivalent

varios-vis.desc: creating new VIs and closing or saving them all at once. The editor already has several VIs open (DT-045), but they are only opened with Open or as subVIs

versiones-del-formato.desc: saving a VI in an earlier version of the .qvi format. Today only version 1 exists

imprimir.desc: printing a VI: its documentation or its windows

propiedades-del-vi.desc: the VI properties dialog and where what it sets is saved in the .qvi

recientes.desc: the list of recently opened VIs and projects

sub-vis.desc: the VIs from LabVIEW's libraries that are used as subVIs (the ones the palette brings). Using your own VI as a subVI is already done (DT-045)

patrones-del-connector.desc: the other 35 connector pane patterns and the commands that change the pattern: Add and Remove Terminal, Rotate and Flip

clones-compartidos.desc: reentrancy with shared clones, which recursion needs, and the inlining of a subVI

jerarquia-de-vis.desc: what LabVIEW knows about VIs that call each other: Find All Instances, Show VI Hierarchy, Relink To SubVI and the rest of the commands of a subVI node

acciones-mecanicas.desc: the five missing mechanical actions (Switch When Released, Switch Until Released and the three Latch ones): when a Boolean control changes and when it returns by itself. The Latch ones depend on how a VI runs while it is running
acciones-mecanicas.ref: design/labview-plan.md M2 and M4: execution decision pending

tipo-cluster.desc: the cluster type: grouping values of different types into one. Radio buttons are a cluster of Booleans

dialogos-de-usuario.desc: the user's modal dialog boxes: a message with one, two or three buttons, or with a field to type in. The error one is already there (Simple Error Handler and automatic handling)

estructura-de-eventos.desc: the Event structure and the panel activity functions, which wait for what the user does

tipo-set-map.desc: the Set and Map types and their controls

arrays-2d.desc: what is missing of two-dimensional arrays (the arrays themselves are done, DT-044): Reshape Array, Transpose 2D Array, Sort and Shuffle 2D and the Matrix functions, which do not compile yet

arrays-mas-de-2d.desc: arrays of three or more dimensions: the compiler handles two, and Add Dimension is greyed out when they are reached

tipo-array.desc: the array type in WebAssembly: array constants, controls and indicators and their functions

tipo-ruta.desc: the path type, with File I/O
tipo-ruta.ref: design/labview-plan.md: Controls ▸ String & Path and File I/O

express-vis.desc: Express VIs: nodes with a configuration dialog and dynamic signals

vis-maleables.desc: malleable VIs (.vim) and the Type Specialization structure, which adapt the code to the wired type

tipo-timestamp.desc: LabVIEW's time stamp type (128 bits: seconds since 1904 and a fraction), with its controls, constants and conversions

estructuras-de-control.desc: the other diagram structures: Case, Flat Sequence, Event, Timed, In Place Element, Formula Node and the two for disabling code

variables-y-feedback.desc: local, global and shared variables and the Feedback Node

decoraciones.desc: the diagram's decorations: frames, captions and arrows for tidying it up

paginas-web.desc: Web pages that Solder can send the user to: its documentation, downloads and support. There are none yet

auto-grow.desc: Auto Grow: a structure that grows by itself when an object is brought close to it

paralelismo-de-bucles.desc: splitting the iterations of a For Loop among several threads

variables-de-secuencia.desc: the sequence locals of the Stacked Sequence: Add Sequence Local, writing it in one frame and reading it in the later ones

registros-apilados.desc: multi-element shift registers, which keep several previous iterations at once

canales.desc: channel wires and the Channel Writer and Channel Reader nodes

historial-de-revisiones.desc: The revision history of a VI and the run-time menu that the VI shows when it runs

instantaneas-de-vi.desc: VI snippets: the selection saved as a picture that carries its diagram

buscar-y-reemplazar.desc: Find and Replace, and its list of search results

valores-por-defecto.desc: Make Current Value Default and Reinitialize to Default of a chart or a graph: the data it shows when the VI opens (controls and indicators have them, DT-053)

crear-subvi.desc: Create SubVI: the selected nodes or wires become a new VI, replaced by a call to it

crear-escalar.desc: Create ▸ Scalar on an array terminal: the constant or control of the array's element type, not of the array

escalas-de-graficas.desc: The scales of a graph beyond the autoscale: formatting, markers, styles, mapping, the optional planes and the Scale Legend

cursores-y-anotaciones.desc: The cursors, the annotations and the Graph Palette of a graph, to read and mark points at run time

trazos-de-graficas.desc: How each plot looks and the legend that lists them: colour, line style and width, points, bars, fill and interpolation, with the menus of the legend and of the swatch of a plot

modos-de-chart.desc: How a chart is updated: Scope Chart and Sweep Chart (Strip Chart is done), and Stack Plots

graficas-especiales.desc: The other graphs and plots of Controls ▸ Modern ▸ Graph: intensity, digital, mixed signal, polar, 3D…, and the digital display and scrollbar of the ones that exist

exportar-graficas.desc: Copying and exporting the data and the image of a graph: to the clipboard, to Excel, to DIAdem or to a file

copiar-datos.desc: Copy, cut and paste the data of a control or indicator through the clipboard of the system

representaciones-de-enum.desc: an enum with a representation other than U16 (DT-038 fixes every enum as U16)

items-inline.desc: an enum's items edited in the constant itself: Add Item After/Before and Remove Item (measured; the Edit Items dialog already exists)

items-desactivados.desc: disabled enum or ring items, which the selector does not offer

resaltar-terminal.desc: pointing out in the diagram the terminal of a panel object (Find Terminal)

formato-de-presentacion.desc: how a value is shown: notation, digits, separator (Display Format…)

ajuste-al-panel.desc: panel objects grow with the panel or fill it

adaptar-a-la-fuente.desc: an indicator's type follows that of what it receives (Adapt To Source)

ring.desc: the rings (Text, Menu, Pict and Text & Pict Ring): value and label pairs with free values and Allow undefined values

clases-de-labview.desc: LabVIEW classes: a .lvclass with private data, methods, inheritance and dynamic dispatch, and the functions that convert and query objects of a class

unbundle-add-element.desc: Add Element in the menu of a row of Unbundle By Name: not measured in LabVIEW yet (only stretching the node and Remove Element were)

tipo-variant.desc: The variant type: a value that carries any LabVIEW type with it, with its attributes, and the functions that convert to and from it
